class.name: OSApp
class.brief_description: Base class for OpenDust OS apps.
class.description: An app is a [Control] scene. Extend this class (in GDScript or C++) and override [method _setup] to receive the [OSAppContext]. Register the scene with [method OSKernel.register_app]. The built-in apps ([code]os.home[/code], [code]os.files[/code], [code]os.notes[/code], [code]os.messages[/code]) are OSApps implemented in C++.

method.name: _setup
method.description: Called once when the app is opened.
